featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very bad experience with Jaya Auto. I gave my car for paint work and was told it would be completed in 12 days, but they took more than 40 days to deliver it. There was no proper communication throughout the process, and they did not respond properly on WhatsApp either.

The delay wasted a lot of my time, and even after waiting so long, I am not satisfied with the quality of the work done. Overall, it was a very disappointing experience, and I would not recommend their service.

Reply to owners msg :
You seem to be very quick in replying here, but unfortunately I was expecting the same prompt communication during the time my car was with you for painting and repair work.

My issue is not that work was done on the car. My issue is the delay, lack of proper updates, and the overall experience during the process. If the work involved was so major, then clear timelines and regular communication should have been maintained from your end.

Also, making payment at the time of delivery does not mean the customer is fully satisfied. Many concerns become clear only after using the car for some time.

This review is based on my overall experience, and I stand by it.

I had a okay kind of experience. They are quick in delivery. But I think they lack professional approach & badly missing on post service follow ups. Security of the car once it is dropped at their workshop is a major concern as I don't know whether they have proper CCTV coverage or not. I saw a deep cut on the bonnet when I went to take back my car back & as natural, they swiftly denied that it happened at their site & there was no way to verify that. If proper CCTV coverage was there, it could have been easily figured out. Mr Dilip, agreed to do the touch up work but stopped responding to messages as ensuring that customer is satisfied in not their motto. So whoever wants to go to them, please take snaps of your entire car beforehand.

He has fixed the cut on the bonnet at no extra cost, I view this act as a positive because I value post sale service the most. And delivered the vehicle same day! It is definitely a value for money work shop & delivery time is quite reasonable. Thank you Dilipji

featured_reviews.name: Aaren Martis
featured_reviews.review_text: Never going here, highly overpriced, he quoted me 450 for just putting mirror's and a sump guard, that too I helped the mechanic as no one else was there to assist. While speaking to the owner he was very rude and was raising his voice when I negotiated and in the end he just hung up, I yet paid 300 as the mechanic was humble and honestly told me it's not a right price that's the reason I gave you the phone, on the first instance also he charged me around 4k for a job that should cost 2.5 but I was not aware and he took advantage of it. I suggest to go to other mechanics in bandra and khar who are much better and polite with their customers.

featured_reviews.name: Anand Tuliani
featured_reviews.review_text: This shop exists since 1987. Sharma ji, the main mechanic, is highly experienced with Royal Enfield motorcycles. He's good with other motorcycles too. Nice person, reasonable rates, good service. Don't go by the looks of the shop. Highly recommended!
